summary: Ten US anytime-goalscorer requests cost 10 credits, 481 remaining. The book rate is minutes-scaled and capped by the match line. Haaland stays at 0.58 goals and 4.80 points. The free transfer stays van Ewijk to Hall. The wildcard lead over that transfer falls from 13.22 to 5.29 across Gameweeks 6 and 7, and the rebuild still sells Haaland. The Odds API has no Premier League ranking market, so Gameweek 8 onward stays unknown. This is not a chip rule.
